verdict.rationale: The evidence supports child workflows: steps can hold function invocations (inngest-docs-2), child runs triggered via event or invoke inherit parent sessions (inngest-docs-4), and sub-agents can run as separate Inngest functions (inngest-docs-35). Inngest also handles coordination and flow control for you (inngest-docs-1). However, nothing in the pack documents parallel step execution or fan-out/fan-in over dynamic batches. Missing for 10: documented parallel steps, fan-out/fan-in over dynamic batches with result aggregation, independent hands-on corroboration of composed workflows.
